battle.name: 賽約河之戰
battle.theater: 匈牙利穆希城西紹約河畔
battle.brief: 1241年4月11日，拔都、速不台率蒙古遠征軍在匈牙利穆希城西南的紹約河畔，與貝拉四世王率的匈牙利王國軍及奧地利、聖殿騎士團援軍決戰。匈牙利人以弩兵守住車陣營壘，蒙古軍卻以七台投石機壓制橋上弩手，並由昔班、速不台兩翼迂回合圍，最終殲滅匈牙利主力。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰方分成兩大陣營。蒙古帝國方面是拔都、速不台、昔班、不里、別兒哥、孛栾台等蒙古王公領率的遠征軍，兵種以弓騎兵為骨幹，輔以槍騎兵，攜帶至少七台投石機這類配重式與配射式攻城器械，隊伍中可能還編有來自南宋的火器與火藥武器部隊；得拔都授權的合丹另率一支追擊部隊，專責搜索匈牙利王室。匈牙利方面是貝拉四世王率領的匈牙利王國軍，兵員來自阿爾帕德王朝封臣的徵召，編有步兵、弩兵與輕騎兵，並有克羅地亞與達爾馬提亞的部隊參戰，卡洛喬大主教烏格林·恰克、斯拉沃尼亞公爵科洛曼、馬蒂亞斯·拉托特、丹尼斯·托馬伊各領一軍。奧地利公國公爵腓特烈二世率奧地利與施蒂利亞兵馬赴援，聖殿騎士團團長倫巴爾德·德·沃宗率團參戰。兩邊的編制體質完全對不上：蒙古軍是統一的百戶制與怯薛親衛體系，騎射為本、分進合擊；匈牙利軍則是各自為戰的封建徵召兵與各色傭兵混編，號令難一。
countriesEn: The two sides fell into two clearly defined camps. On the Mongol side stood the expeditionary army of the Mongol Empire under the princes Batu, Subutai, Siban, Burlı, Börgön and Tolui, organised primarily as mounted archers with a supporting body of lancers, and equipped with at least seven mangonels, the traction and counterweight siege engines of the period; the force may also have included firearm and gunpowder units recruited from the Southern Song, while a separate column under Qadan, acting on Batu's authority, was given the task of hunting the Hungarian royal family. On the Hungarian side was the royal army of the Kingdom of Hungary led by King Béla IV, drawn from the feudal levies of the Árpád dynasty and including infantry, crossbowmen and light cavalry, together with contingents from the Croatian and Dalmatian crown lands; the army was led in the field by the Archbishop of Kalocsa Ugrin Csák, the Duke of Slavonia Coloman, Matthias Rátót and Denis Tomaj. Duke Frederick II of the Duchy of Austria arrived with troops from Austria and Styria, and the Knights Templar entered the field under their master Rembald de Voczon. The two systems of organisation did not match at all: the Mongol army rested on a unified decimal organisation and a body of personal guard, riding and shooting being the core of its drill and the columns converging by stages; the Hungarian army was a mixed force of feudal levies and hired men from many masters, each answerable only to his own banner, so that a single order could not be passed down the line.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。匈牙利國王貝拉四世是全軍名義上的統帥，卻在最要緊的幾個鐘頭裡遲遲不下達作戰命令，烏格林大主教當眾指責他失職。他的弟弟斯拉沃尼亞公爵科洛曼，聯同烏格林與聖殿騎士團團長倫巴爾德·德·沃宗在午夜離營，奪下紹約河橋，殲滅蒙古先遣隊，回營後還慶祝勝利，卻在黎明後誤把蒙古主力的到來當作又一次騷擾，結果全軍覆沒。貝拉與科洛曼僥倖逃出，科洛曼不久因傷重不治。蒙古方面，拔都是大軍主帥，晨間強攻中折損三十名巴特爾即親衛戰士，先鋒將領巴卡圖陣亡，他自己一度因為傷亡過重而想撤退；速不台自北方淺灘迂回，又在南面架設急造橋，會合之後完成合圍，並在拔都欲退時堅持繼續進攻。昔班率小股兵力北渡淺灘，專責攻擊橋上的匈牙利守軍。戰後拔都與速不台為功勞互相歸咎，貴由與不里當面指責拔都無能，拔都遂將二人逐回哈拉和林，交由窩闊台裁決。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities divide into two groups. King Béla IV of Hungary was the nominal commander of the whole host, yet through the crucial hours he never gave the order to fight, and the archbishop Ugrin publicly accused him of dereliction of duty. His brother Coloman, Duke of Slavonia, together with Ugrin and Rembald de Voczon, master of the Knights Templar, left the camp at midnight, took the bridge over the Sajó and destroyed a Mongol advance detachment, rode back to camp to celebrate the stroke, and at daybreak then mistook the coming of the Mongol main body for another raid, with the whole army wiped out in consequence. Béla and Coloman escaped by luck, and Coloman died shortly afterwards of his wounds. On the Mongol side Batu was the commander of the host; in the morning assault he lost thirty of his ba'atur, the personal guard, and his vanguard leader Bakatu was killed, and for a time he was minded to break off because the casualties were so heavy. Subutai swung north through a shallow ford and threw up a hurried bridge to the south, joined the other columns and completed the encirclement, and when Batu wished to withdraw he insisted on continuing the attack. Siban took a small body north across the shallows with the task of striking the Hungarian bridge guard. After the battle Batu and Subutai blamed each other for the losses, Güyük and Burlı accused Batu to his face of incapacity, and Batu sent them back to Qaraqorum to be judged by Ögedei.
kits: 本戰的卡面兵器是十字弩，年代定於1100年前後，屬歐洲陸戰裝備。弩在這場戰役中屬匈牙利軍隊序列中的主力投射兵器，兵種表把弩兵單獨列出。午夜奪橋時，匈牙利人正是靠橋頭的弩陣打亂蒙古先遣隊，蒙古人毫無防備地渡橋，遭重創，餘部被逼落河中溺斃，斯普利特的托馬斯記下匈牙利人斬殺多人、把其餘逼退回橋上的情形。同一批弩兵在黎明後又成為蒙古投石機的首要目標，拔都下令以七台投石機清除對岸的匈牙利弩手，橋頭守軍才得撤回營。弩的弱點也一樣清楚：裝填緩慢，野戰中難以維持射速，蒙古弓騎兵以更快的拋射節奏與迂回包抄來應對，匈牙利弩手退入營地之後只靠石彈與火箭壓制，弩的火力便無從施展。營地本身是匈牙利軍用牛車與帳幕圍成的環形車陣，本是對付遊牧騎兵的標準手段，遇上有攻城器械的敵手反成累贅。蒙古軍這邊除投石機外，還帶來火藥武器、火箭與石腦油火彈，以及高機動的弓騎兵與槍騎兵。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the crossbow, dated to around 1100 and belonging to the European land repertoire. Within the Hungarian order of battle the crossbow was one of the principal missile weapons, and the list of units names crossbowmen as a formed body in their own right. At midnight it was the Hungarian crossbow line at the head of the bridge that disordered the Mongol advance guard, which was caught crossing without precautions and was badly mauled, the survivors driven back onto the bridge and drowned in the river; the Archdeacon of Split records that the Hungarians cut down many of them and forced the rest back onto the bridge. The same crossbowmen became the first target of the Mongol mangonels at daybreak, Batu ordering seven of them to clear the Hungarian crossbowmen from the far bank before the bridge guard could be driven off. The weakness of the weapon was just as visible: slow to reload and unable to sustain a rate of fire in open country, the Mongol mounted archers answered it with a faster rhythm of shooting and with encirclement, and once the Hungarian crossbowmen were penned inside the camp, stone shot and incendiary arrows were enough to neutralise them and the crossbow never came into its own. The camp itself was a ring laager of ox-drawn carts and tents, the standard answer to nomadic cavalry, which turned into a liability once the enemy brought siege engines with him. On the Mongol side, besides the mangonels, came gunpowder weapons, fire arrows and naphtha bombs, and the highly mobile mass of mounted archers and lancers.
tactics: 戰術層面上兩軍差異極為明顯。蒙古軍的部署是典型的多路合圍：拔都自正面以七台投石機壓制橋上守軍，同時清除對岸的弩手；昔班率小股兵力北渡淺灘，從背後夾擊橋樑守軍；速不台則南下到更淺的渡口搭建一座急造橋，繞到匈牙利軍隊背後，等三支部隊會合之後才發動總攻。匈牙利軍的戰術核心是車陣營壘，用牛車與帳幕圍成環形防禦圈，本是對付遊牧騎兵的標準答案，可一旦對手帶來攻城器械，這圈車陣反倒成了無法轉身的累贅。蒙古軍的進攻次序是先以投石機投射石彈清理橋上與營前的弩手，再以火箭與火藥武器覆蓋車陣，逼守軍離營出戰，最後封住刻意留出的缺口，把潰逃者逐批屠殺。匈牙利軍敗在指揮節奏：奪橋得手後回營慶祝，把蒙古主力當成小規模襲擾，國王遲遲不下令作戰，營中留守者只等著科洛曼再勝一場，而貴族對國王的忠誠本來就有限。
tacticsEn: At the level of tactics the two armies differed sharply. The Mongol deployment was a classic multi-axis encirclement: Batu pressed the bridge from the front with seven mangonels while clearing the crossbowmen from the far bank; Siban took a small body north across the shallows to fall on the bridge guard from behind; and Subutai moved south to a shallower crossing to throw up a hurried bridge, come round onto the rear of the Hungarian army, and only when the three columns had joined was the general assault launched. The core of the Hungarian plan was the wagon camp, a ring of ox-drawn carts and tents, the standard answer to nomadic cavalry, which turned into a liability that could not manoeuvre once the enemy brought siege engines against it. The Mongol sequence of attack was to clear the crossbowmen on the bridge and in front of the camp with stone shot, then to blanket the laager with incendiary arrows and gunpowder weapons, drive the defenders out into the open, and finally seal the gap that had deliberately been left open, cutting down the fugitives in successive batches. The Hungarian defeat lay as much in the rhythm of command: after taking the bridge the knights rode back to camp to celebrate, taking the Mongol main body for a small raid, the king gave no order to engage, those left in the camp merely waited for Coloman to win again as he had done before, and the loyalty of the barons to their king was in any case thin.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。日期為1241年4月11日，決戰自午夜前奪橋起，一直延續到翌日下午。蒙古軍兵力方面，拉施德丁記載中歐攻勢共投入四萬騎兵，分為五路，其中抵達匈牙利境內的實際到場兵力約一萬五千至三萬騎，現代學者多取約兩萬之數，並至少配備七台投石機。匈牙利軍的規模分歧極大：同時代文獻有八萬、四萬之說，現代估算降到約兩萬五千；最接近實情的《埃普特納赫記錄》記載匈牙利軍損失一萬人，可據此推測全軍規模也在這個量級。傷亡方面，匈牙利軍陣亡約一萬，幾乎等於全軍；蒙古軍沒有可靠統計，估計從數百到數千不等，拔都的巴特爾折損三十人，先鋒指揮官巴卡圖陣亡。地理數字上，紹約河橋長度至少二百公尺，奪橋前最後七公里是夜間行軍，匈牙利軍自佩斯方向急行軍約一週才抵達河畔。戰後營地帳幕被付火焚燒，匈牙利王室一路被追到亞得里亞海沿岸。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. The date is 11 April 1241, and the battle ran from the seizure of the bridge before midnight into the afternoon of the following day. On the Mongol strength, Rashid al-Din records 40,000 horsemen committed to the Central European offensive, divided into five columns, of whom those actually present in Hungary numbered about 15,000 to 30,000 riders; modern writers generally take about 20,000, and there were at least seven mangonels. The size of the Hungarian army is disputed far more violently: contemporary documents give 80,000 and 40,000, while modern estimates fall to about 25,000; the closest to the mark is the Epternach notice, which records 10,000 Hungarians lost, from which it may be inferred that the whole host was of much that order. On casualties, about 10,000 Hungarians were killed, very nearly the whole army; for the Mongols there is no reliable count, estimates running from several hundred to several thousand, thirty of Batu's ba'atur lost and the vanguard commander Bakatu killed. In physical terms, the bridge over the Sajó was at least 200 metres long, the last seven kilometres before the attack were covered in darkness, and the Hungarian host took roughly a week of forced marching from the direction of Pest to reach the river. After the fighting the tents in the camp were fired and burned, and the Hungarian royal family was driven as far as the Adriatic coast.
cause: 打起來的緣由分幾層。最遠的一層是蒙古第一次西征與匈牙利王國在邊境上的相撞：1223年蒙古軍在卡爾卡河擊敗基輔羅斯與庫曼汗國的聯軍，此後數十年匈牙利一方面想拉攏庫曼人改信基督教，另一方面在蒙古人眼中，匈牙利收留約四萬庫曼難民、讓庫曼人得到國王庇護，等於把蒙古的附庸與競爭者安置在側翼，於是蒙古的最後通牒裡出現了「使者失蹤」的指控，成為開戰的藉口。直接的一層是蒙古軍的逼近：1241年3月15日先鋒抵達佩斯並掠奪郊區，貝拉四世禁止部下出擊，奧地利公爵腓特烈二世的小股追擊雖然得手，卻拋下盟友返國。內部的一層是匈牙利自身的震動：貝拉即位後收回安德拉什二世大量賜地、取消貴族當面陳情之權，貴族普遍怨恨；卡洛喬大主教烏格林率重騎攻擊卻被引入沼澤而深陷，行宮伯爵所部與南線部隊相繼被殲，數萬庫曼人又因恐懼南撤，匈牙利遂在主力尚未集結、士氣已崩的狀態下被迫迎戰。
causeEn: The coming to blows has several layers. The most distant is the collision of the Mongols' first expedition westward with the frontier of the Kingdom of Hungary: in 1223 the Mongol army defeated an allied host of Kievan Rus and the Kipchak Khanate on the Kalka, and over the following decades Hungary had tried both to draw the Kipchaks to Christianity and, in the Mongols' eyes, to shelter some 40,000 Kipchak refugees and place them under the king's protection, which was in effect to install the Mongols' own vassals and rivals on their flank; the last ultimatum from the Mongols accordingly charged Hungary with the disappearance of envoys, and that became the pretext for war. The immediate layer is the approach of the Mongol army: on 15 March 1241 the vanguard reached Pest and raided the surrounding country, Béla IV forbade his men to counter-attack, and though a small pursuit by the troops of Duke Frederick II of Austria succeeded, the duke left his allies and went home. The internal layer is the upheaval in Hungary itself: on taking the throne Béla had recovered the vast grants of land made by Andrew II and taken away the barons' right to petition in person, and the nobility was universally embittered; the Archbishop Ugrin led his heavy cavalry into a marsh and was swallowed by it, the army of the Palatine and the southern detachment were annihilated in turn, and tens of thousands of Kipchaks, panicked, withdrew to the south. Hungary was thus driven to give battle with its main force not yet assembled and its morale already broken.
impact: 穆希之戰的後果遠出戰場之外。匈牙利王國的野戰骨幹在一天之內被消滅，全國再無可用之兵，國王只能一路被追到亞得里亞海沿岸的特羅吉爾要塞，妻兒逃往奧地利又被腓特烈二世扣押勒索，並被迫割讓三個西部郡縣。匈牙利此後改變防務政策，開始准許貴族興築石造城堡與要塞，以抵禦同類型的機動性入侵，這項制度轉變深刻改寫了中世紀東歐的城防格局。消息傳遍歐洲後，從法蘭西到卡斯蒂利亞的基督教世界陷入恐慌，此後數十年，蒙古西征的陰影一直影響歐洲的軍事設計與外交。蒙古方面，拔都與速不台為功勞互相歸咎，內部裂痕公開化，貴由與不里被逐回哈拉和林交由窩闊台裁決，拔都的主帥權威受損，遠征軍的架構也隨之削弱。
impactEn: The consequences of the battle of Muhi reached far beyond the field. The field backbone of the Kingdom of Hungary was destroyed in the space of a single day and the kingdom had no field army left; the king was pursued to the fortress of Trogir on the Adriatic coast, his wife and children fled to Austria and were there detained and extorted by Duke Frederick II, and three western counties had to be ceded to pay the price. Hungary afterwards changed its defensive policy and began to allow the nobility to build stone castles and fortresses against an invader of the same kind of mobility, and that institutional reversal rewrote the fortification landscape of medieval eastern Europe in ways that endured. As the news travelled across Europe, from France to Castile the Christian world was seized by panic, and for decades the shadow of the Mongol expeditions continued to shape European military design and diplomacy. On the Mongol side the quarrel between Batu and Subutai over credit for the victory opened internal rifts in public, Güyük and Burlı were sent back to Qaraqorum to be judged by Ögedei, Batu's authority as commander was impaired, and the structure of the expeditionary army was weakened in consequence.
result: 結果是蒙古帝國的完勝。匈牙利王國的野戰軍在紹約河畔被包圍分割，突圍嘗試全部失敗，車陣營壘被石彈、火箭與火藥武器摧毀，潰兵從蒙古人故意留出的缺口逃出時遭到屠殺，營內貴族爭相逃亡，最後只餘數百人隨國王與公爵逃出戰場。大主教烏格林、另兩位大主教、三位主教及多名高級官員戰死；科洛曼公爵雖逃出戰場，卻因傷重不久身亡。拔都雖折損三十名巴特爾、失去先鋒將領巴卡圖，仍在速不台的堅持下完成合圍，把戰役推向決定性結局。戰後蒙古軍放棄搜刮戰利品，改為追擊殘部並控制匈牙利大平原、喀爾巴阡山脈北麓與特蘭西瓦尼亞，佩斯被攻陷焚毀，埃斯泰爾戈姆被圍而不強攻城堡，因為首要目標是活捉貝拉四世。匈牙利此後進入漫長的重建期。
resultEn: The result was a complete Mongol victory. The field army of the Kingdom of Hungary was encircled and cut apart beside the Sajó, every attempt to break out failed, the wagon laager was destroyed by stone shot, incendiary arrows and gunpowder weapons, and the men who fled through the gap the Mongols had deliberately left open were cut down; inside the camp the barons fled in droves, and only a few hundred men left the field with the king and the duke. The archbishop Ugrin, two further archbishops, three bishops and a number of high officials were killed; the Duke Coloman escaped the field but died shortly afterwards of his wounds. Batu, though he had lost thirty of his ba'atur and his vanguard leader Bakatu, still completed the encirclement because Subutai refused to withdraw, and carried the battle to a decisive conclusion. After the fighting the Mongols gave up plundering the camp and turned instead to hunting the survivors and taking control of the Hungarian plain, the northern foothills of the Carpathians and Transylvania; Pest was stormed and burned, Esztergom was surrounded but its castle was not assaulted, because the first objective was to take Béla IV alive. Hungary then entered a long period of reconstruction.
